{{Top|ca|leg}}
'''Venestrian poetry''' was a form of [[Poet/Legends|poetry]]<ref name="Journal3">{{JournalCite|3|Blasters for Hire}}</ref> that originated at<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Venestrian [[Poet/Legends|poetry]]|system=[[Venestria system/Legends|Venestria system]] and [[Venestria]] itself|legends=1}}</ref> the celestial body [[Venestria]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Clacis sector/Legends|Clacis sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Venestria system/Legends|Venestria system]]</ref> Not long after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Journal3" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during its operations against the [[Pentastar Alignment]] splinter faction of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Red Moons]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization arranged for Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]]&mdash;with their [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]] filled with important shipping manifests&mdash;to randomly appear at [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] intelligence points while babbling esoteric Venestrian poetry.<ref name="Journal3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Venestrian poetry was mentioned in "[[Blasters for Hire]]," a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tony Russo|Anthony P. Russo]] and published in the [[August]] [[1994]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 3|third issue]] of [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Journal3" />
